text:
Anna: Quick check for tomorrow's RFC review — can we tweak the author order? Priya just flagged a calendar conflict for the first slot.
Mike: I'm fine taking Priya's RFC if it moves later.
Jorge: I can swap with Priya and also combine my 5-min design note into her slot if that helps.
Priya: Thanks — swapping works for me. I'll add a short demo gif and a one-page TL;DR to the pre-read. link: https://redwood/internal/rfcs/42/pre-read
Anna: Awesome. Draft agenda (times are mins):
```
1) Intro & housekeeping — 5
2) Jorge + Priya combo (RFC 42 + design note) — 20 (15 + 5 demo)
3) Mike — RFC 37 review — 15
4) Open Q&A / followups — 10
```
Can reviewers confirm availability: @Mike, @Sam? Also thinking we should assign primary/secondary reviewers so followups are clear.
Sam: I can be secondary for the Jorge+Priya slot. Primary for Mike's RFC works for me.
Mike: I'll be primary on the Jorge+Priya combo if needed, but prefer to remain primary on RFC 37. So plan: Mike primary on 37, Sam primary on combo, Anna as backup.
Anna: Perfect. Priya — please add a 1-paragraph acceptance criteria section to the pre-read by EOD so reviewers know what to look for.
Priya: Will do. ETA 5pm PST.
eng-bot: Reminder scheduled — RFC review reminder will post in #eng 30 minutes before the meeting. :bell:
Anna: Last nit — do we want to surface any rollout concerns in the agenda? I think we should put a 2-min 'risks' callout in each slot.
Jorge: Agreed, I'll add a short 'deploy considerations' section to my note.
Anna: Thanks everyone — I'll update the calendar order and send a final thread summary in 10m. :thumbsup:
